curriculum.note: The Cambridge Lower Secondary Mathematics framework is not in this class folder on Google Drive, which holds only scanned resource packs with no text layer, so this map works at sub-strand level. The four strands, the sub-strand names and the eight Thinking and Working Mathematically characteristics are the published Cambridge ones; only the individual objective numbers are missing. Note that lower secondary adds Algebra as a full strand, which primary does not have, and that Cambridge does not report on Thinking and Working Mathematically at sub-strand level.
